edits.label: metadata.description
edits.old: Learn about My Square Face Icon, a free browser-based square face generator focused on cute profile icons, privacy, and original avatar resources.
edits.new: Learn about My Square Face Icon, its browser-based avatar tools, curated examples, community gallery, privacy practices, and unverified game-file rights.

edits.label: metadata.twitter.description
edits.old: Learn why My Square Face Icon exists and how the site approaches free avatar tools, privacy, and original content.
edits.new: Learn how My Square Face Icon handles avatar tools, curated examples, community submissions, privacy, and unverified game-file rights.

edits.label: What We Provide / third card H3
What We Provide / third card paragraph
edits.old: Gallery examples are created for this site as inspiration. They are not copied from competitors, user comments, or third-party art packs.
edits.new: The homepage shows site-curated icon examples. The gallery includes simple style examples and approved community submissions when available. Selection or moderation does not establish authorship or grant image-use permissions.

edits.label: Rights section / first paragraph
edits.old: The site does not copy competitor page text, screenshots, image libraries, comments, or downloadable assets. The main tool uses the square face game file that was provided for this project, while new examples and support content are written specifically for My Square Face Icon.
edits.new: Square and Oval run third-party Flash (SWF) files through Ruffle. We have not verified the original source, rights holder, or permissions for the exact files used here, including hosting, public use, redistribution, and use of generated images. The site's availability and examples do not establish authorization or grant third-party rights.

edits.label: Next Product Direction / Browse the gallery paragraph
edits.old: See original square face icon ideas for style inspiration.
edits.new: Browse style ideas and approved community submissions when available.
